partners.mechanism_chain: CASQ2 (HGNC:2034) —DISRUPTS→ calcium buffering in sarcoplasmic reticulum (GO:0031575); calcium buffering in sarcoplasmic reticulum (GO:0031575) —LEADS_TO→ Prieto syndrome (MONDO:0010667); CASQ2 (HGNC:2034) —DISRUPTS→ cardiac calcium release (GO:0003010); cardiac calcium release (GO:0003010) —LEADS_TO→ catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia 2 (MONDO:0012762). Mutations in CASQ2 can lead to loss-of-function, impairing calcium buffering in the sarcoplasmic reticulum and causing Prieto syndrome.
